//: Policy for this repo, read by .github/scripts/merge-gate.mjs. Strict JSON — that script JSON.parse()s it, so comments must be "//" keys, never // lines.
name: plenipo-agents

autonomy.//: level: 0 nothing · 1 docs+tests · 2 features on review · 3 unattended. Set by a human, never inferred — an agent deciding it has earned autonomy is the self-approving loop wearing a different hat.
autonomy.//set-by: A human set this to 3 in words on 2026-08-01, having been told the ladder's stated entry requirement ('level 2 clean over a stretch') was unmet: this repo had never merged autonomously at any level. Recorded here because that is the fact a future tick needs and the conversation is gone.
autonomy.//what-3-means-here: merge-gate.mjs treats *.md as low-risk, so in an all-markdown repo levels 1 and 3 both cover almost everything. Level 3 also permits non-markdown verifier and workflow changes. This repo relies on one required deterministic check (`Validate marketplace`) plus one required approving CODEOWNER review over every path; automation alone cannot merge any change.
autonomy.//ci-simplified: A human explicitly simplified PR checks in August 2026 after the old PR gate recorded more failures than successes and the automatic cloud reviewer reached only 50% workflow health, mostly from provider 429s. The removed `human-approved` label gate duplicated the wildcard CODEOWNER approval already enforced by the ruleset. Do not restore intentionally-red or automatic model checks without measured evidence that they catch defects the validator and human review miss.
autonomy.//merges-by-hand: DELIBERATE, and not a misconfiguration to fix. This repo's ruleset requires one approving review from a CODEOWNER, and CODEOWNERS is `* @abrahamFerga` — so every pull request waits for a named human. agent-merge.yml is manual-dispatch only because no cloud verdict can satisfy that review. The reason is blast radius: this marketplace is almost entirely skill prose that agents load and trust without verifying, so a wrong merge here does not break one product, it propagates a false fact into every repo that installs the plugin.
autonomy.//no-cloud-approver-here: Neither pr-approval-verdict.md nor the advisory cloud PR reviewer is installed here. A cloud verdict cannot satisfy the required human review, and the advisory reviewer repeatedly turned provider rate limits into red checks. Use the local plenipo:pr-reviewer on demand. If pr-approval-verdict.md is ever installed, agent-approval-reset.yml must go in at the same time — the reviewer can only ADD labels, so nothing else can withdraw an approval that later commits invalidated.
